# Fonts: the faces of the looks (decisions row 366)

Two open faces, shared by the documentation site and the C player (row 363, point 5). The site
serves them from its own origin, so its policy `default-src 'self'` stands. Fetched 2026-10-12 on
the owner's yes, from jsDelivr's mirror of the Fontsource npm packages, version 5.2.8, Latin
subset.
